details.description: Static API tokens and internal authentication keys are hardcoded in the source, which risks leakage via version control or binary distribution.
details.fix_explanation: Moved secrets to environment variables; code now reads PAYMENT_TOKEN, MAIL_SERVER_KEY, and INTERNAL_AUTH from OS environment and fails safely if missing.
details.secure_code_snippet:
PAYMENT_TOKEN = os.getenv('PAYMENT_TOKEN')
MAIL_SERVER_KEY = os.getenv('MAIL_SERVER_KEY')
INTERNAL_AUTH = os.getenv('INTERNAL_AUTH')

details.description: User-supplied 'id' is interpolated directly into SQL resulting in SQL injection risk.
details.fix_explanation: Replaced string interpolation with a parameterized query (using ? placeholder) and input validation.
details.secure_code_snippet: c.execute("SELECT id,name,balance FROM profiles WHERE id = ?", (uid,))

details.description: Subprocess is invoked with shell=True and user-controlled input (filename), enabling command injection.
details.fix_explanation: Removed shell invocation and used Python's zipfile module to create archives safely and sanitized user-provided names.
details.secure_code_snippet:
with zipfile.ZipFile(zip_path, 'w', zipfile.ZIP_DEFLATED) as zf:
    zf.write(DB_FILE, arcname=os.path.basename(DB_FILE))

details.description: User-controlled path is opened directly allowing reading of files outside intended directory.
details.fix_explanation: Constrain config file access to a dedicated CONFIG_DIR, sanitize filename using os.path.basename and validate resolved path resides inside CONFIG_DIR.
details.secure_code_snippet:
safe_name = os.path.basename(filename)
target_path = os.path.join(CONFIG_DIR, safe_name)
# validate commonpath...
with open(target_path) as f:
    cfg = yaml.safe_load(f)

details.vulnerability_type: Server-Side Request Forgery (SSRF) and unsafe external calls
details.description: The application posts to a notify_url supplied by the user without validation; an attacker could trigger requests to internal services.
details.fix_explanation: Validated notify_url using urlparse and restricted hosts using ALLOWED_NOTIFY_HOSTS environment variable; added timeouts and exception handling.

details.vulnerability_type: Weak cryptography (MD5) and predictable secret usage
details.description: Authentication used MD5 hashing and concatenated a static secret, which is weak and predictable.
details.fix_explanation: Switched to HMAC-SHA256 using the INTERNAL_AUTH secret and secure digest functions.

details.vulnerability_type: Insecure logging of sensitive transfer data
details.description: Transfer details were printed to stdout which may leak sensitive information to logs.
details.fix_explanation: Avoid printing sensitive transfer data; use structured logs with redaction and proper log levels (not implemented here to keep minimal changes).
details.secure_code_snippet: # Avoid printing full transfer details; log minimally or not at all

details.description: app.run(debug=True) was enabled which can expose interactive debugger and sensitive internals.
details.fix_explanation: Require explicit DEBUG environment flag to enable debug server; default to non-debug mode.
